title: Autonomous Macro & Geopolitical Situation Report (SITREP) Schema
description: Formal JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 data contract for consolidated real-time macro telemetry, chokepoint AIS, and media reality check contagion rules.

text_endpoint.description: Canonical URI of the synchronized human/LLM plain text markdown twin (llms-sitrep.txt).

causal_chain.description: Deterministic transmission vector sequence (A -> B -> C).

metals_commodities.description: Precious metals and industrial commodities telemetry. Note: 'gold_spot_usd_ozt' represents live physical spot benchmark via The Royal Mint converted using the ECB GBP/USD cross rate. 'gold_wb_monthly_usd_ozt' represents official macroeconomic monthly benchmark (World Bank Pink Sheet).

gold_spot_usd_ozt.description: Physical live spot gold price in USD per troy ounce (Source: The Royal Mint Sovereign Spot Benchmark, calculated via ECB GBP/USD cross rate).

gold_spot_gbp_ozt.description: Physical live spot gold price in GBP per troy ounce (Source: The Royal Mint).

silver_spot_usd_ozt.description: Physical live spot silver price in USD per troy ounce (Source: The Royal Mint, calculated via ECB GBP/USD cross rate).

silver_spot_gbp_ozt.description: Physical live spot silver price in GBP per troy ounce (Source: The Royal Mint).

ecb_gbp_usd_cross_rate.description: Official ECB GBP/USD reference exchange rate used for London physical spot currency translation.

fx_observation_date.description: Observation date of the ECB exchange rate and Royal Mint spot feed.

gold_wb_monthly_usd_ozt.description: Macroeconomic monthly benchmark gold price in USD per troy ounce (Source: World Bank Pink Sheet series IND_WB_GOLD).

gold_wb_monthly_yoy_pct.description: Year-over-year percentage change for World Bank gold benchmark.

silver_wb_monthly_usd_ozt.description: Macroeconomic monthly benchmark silver price in USD per troy ounce (Source: World Bank Pink Sheet series IND_WB_SILVER).

silver_wb_monthly_yoy_pct.description: Year-over-year percentage change for World Bank silver benchmark.

gold_silver_ratio.description: Live gold-to-silver price ratio (calculated primarily via physical spot benchmark).

copper_global_usd_mt.description: Global copper price in USD per metric ton.

copper_yoy_pct.description: Year-over-year percentage change for global copper.

wheat_global_usd_mt.description: Global wheat price in USD per metric ton.

wheat_yoy_pct.description: Year-over-year percentage change for global wheat.

systemic_contagion_rules.description: Deterministic rules for validating mainstream news narratives against physical ground truth telemetry.
